sources.title: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Models | huggingface/transformers | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures in the transformers library provide a scalable way to increase model capacity (total parameters) while keeping inference compute costs relatively constant. This is achieved by replacing standard Feed-Forward Network (FFN) layers with sparse MoE blocks that route tokens to a subset of available "experts."
